record.question: A cyclone that cause disasters in Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Northeast India including Mizoram in May 2017 was
record.explanation: Answer B: Cyclone Mora. Mora was the late-May 2017 Bay of Bengal cyclone. IMD’s original report dates it 28–31 May 2017 and its Bangladesh landfall 30 May; it subsequently weakened over northeast India. The other named cyclones belong to different months/years. Historical/source note: The identified late-May 2017 cyclone; the source’s broad list of affected places should not imply every disaster in those countries was caused solely by Mora. Reference: https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/uploads/report/27/27_bbaf11_rsmc-2017.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
